metadata.name: spx_es_3m
metadata.description: Synthetic three-month E-mini S&P 500 futures contract.
metadata.source_detail: Finstack Quant canonical pricing calculation on deterministic synthetic market inputs The canonical typed market inputs are supplied with no calibration steps. Pricing tolerance contracts preserved.
metadata.regen_command: manual formula fixture; values captured from canonical pricing runner

plan.description: the canonical typed market inputs are supplied with no calibration steps. Routes through engine::calibrate without changing pricing math.

npv.tolerance_reason: Formula self-test: tolerance pinned to ~10x the worst observed deterministic FP residual (1.16e-10 abs / 2.8e-11 rel) for canonical pricing on synthetic inputs. Tightening from 1e-6 to 1e-9 catches drift introduced by refactors, FP-contract changes, or algorithm swaps that would otherwise be invisible at the looser band.
